title: Inclusion of Revaluation Reserve in Cash Flow Statement attracts Disciplinary Actions: ICAI reprimands Bank's Auditor [Read Order]
keywords: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
ICAI Disciplinary Action against Banks' auditor
Revaluation reserve in cash flow statement

excerpt: Inclusion of revaluation reserve, being a non-cash item, in the in the cash flow statement under investing activities is not in compliance with the AS-3.
